means.example-sentence: This author writes in her book about her experience of being discriminated against as a child.
means.sentence-jp: この著者は、著書の中で子供のころに差別された経験について書いている。

cloze.maskedText: This author writes in her book about her experience of being ____ as a child.

notes: 「差別する」の意味では discriminate は自動詞なので、他動詞的に目的語をとるには前置詞が必要。
